node.statement: For each t, 1.3 gives Z_t in calUbar_{C_path*g}, so Z_t has a right inverse and ||Z_t^dagger bold-dot Z_t-J||<=2*C_path*g. The strict receiving guard in 1.2 gives C_path*g<delta-C_pol*r, hence ||Z_t^dagger bold-dot Z_t-J||<2*(delta-C_pol*r). By def-approximate-unitary-space, Z_t lies in calU_{delta-C_pol*r}; the inclusion supplied in 1.4 therefore puts Z_t in S_delta. Consequently u_delta(Z_t) in the contract is the well-typed unique first component of the inverse of that same displayed Pi_delta.
